name: spec-layer
description: Figma plugin that turns components and variables into design-system documentation

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/extractor/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/plugin/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/proxy/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:nul && npm test && npm run build:plugin && npm run check:sandbox && npm run check:proxy-dry-run
scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:nul && npm run test:coverage && npm run build:plugin && npm run check:sandbox && npm run check:proxy-dry-run && npm run audit
